subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should iPhone navigation adopt the sidebar-first root shell once the two session-lifecycle regressions are fixed, or should the existing tab-bar model remain the supported phone navigation design?
rationale: The PR deliberately replaces a user-facing navigation paradigm and expands the mobile information architecture; correctness fixes can be mechanical, but the permanent product direction requires the documented owner’s confirmation.

options.title: Adopt sidebar shell after repairs
options.body: Keep the unified sidebar direction, but require persistent New Chat consumption and event-driven roster refresh before merge.

options.title: Retain phone tabs
options.body: Do not merge the root-navigation replacement and keep the existing phone tab model while narrower session-access improvements are evaluated separately.

recommendation.title: Adopt sidebar shell after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the unified sidebar direction, but require persistent New Chat consumption and event-driven roster refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body describes this as maintainer-directed convergence and cites a related navigation-direction issue authored by steipete.
